description: Add a single YouTuber to the database and trigger the full enrichment pipeline (tags, niches, description, similarity, sponsor detection). Returns a batchId you can poll with import_status. Prefer passing a channel ID (UCxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx, 24 chars) — handles ('@xxx') and URLs work too but cost an extra YouTube API quota point per call to resolve.

input.description: Channel ID (UCxxx, preferred), handle ('@xxx'), or full youtube.com URL.

name: youtuber_add
